correctness.rationale: Each projective line type is counted exactly, equality forces one vertical line and pairwise disjoint two-secant partitions. The second-moment identity in odd characteristic is an algebraic contradiction; the trace-image construction in even characteristic works for every permitted field. Eight odd prime covers and representative binary-field covers are checked with exact arithmetic. No inference from finite tests is needed for the universal claims.

value.rationale: Determines a genuinely natural sharpness witness for a current plane-curve covering theorem: a universal strict odd-field equality obstruction plus an exact even-field construction for infinitely many fields and sharp examples in eight odd prime fields.
